note: Template for a new body's reviewed scope (copy to runs/kit2_pass1/pass2_scope_draft.json and review it): the exclusion groups and the a1 II's rows in them, which use Sony's menu names and so mostly carry over. 'prove' is empty: a pass-1 map's rows are its scope. Write each decision, dated, under 'decisions': {"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "rows": [...], "why": "..."}. A decision that opens Wi-Fi and Bluetooth settings, address screens or identity and connection rows also says "lifts": "network" and names each row by its own label: each opens to look only, and "options": {"<row>": ["<option>"]} names the options the kit may choose; a run uses it only with --network, and the default is none (docs/decisions/0008). A decision that says "lifts": "owner" may name any never-open row but a firmware update, what loads a file, and sound, light, motion or the Screen Reader, an action's or a card's by its path (Tab > Group > Row), and say "options", "confirm": ["<row>"], "link_loss": true and "values": "logged"; only kit/drive.py --owner uses it, one row per run (docs/decisions/0004, 0005, 0008 and 0009). A row under 'exclude' stays out of the proofs whatever is decided.
